note: Loop v3 (autoresearch/loop-v3-260925/SPEC-track1.md). Every limit under engines applies to one run = one (arm, seed). seed_screen_score_note: Exact screen combined score of the seed, computed from the saved v2 per-state rows (controls/v2-sort_control_sweep-development.json); _setup_v3 re-evaluates the seed under Seatbelt without cache every run and aborts on a difference above 1e-9.
campaign_max_usd_note: null until the scale (pilot vs full) and the reflection model (O2, O3) are decided; live refuses to start while null.
evox_note: EvoX's outer loop writes and runs LLM-generated Python search strategies; AGENTS.md forbids executing generated code outside the evaluator sandbox, so it is disabled in every run (switch_interval = iterations + 1, variation operators off, post-run leak check).
sky_note: inject_evaluator_context is false. AdaEvolve paradigm prompts still include the staged evaluator stub source (SkyDiscover 0.2.0 adaevolve/controller.py:80-112); the stub holds only the HTTP call.
